note: Role: appears to be a trader/importer-distributor of aftermarket excavator undercarriage parts (crawler chains, sprockets, shrouds, rock buckets) under the ITR group brand, importing from Yantai ITR Industries (China), BYG SAU (Spain), ITR Middle East FZCO (Jebel Ali) and re-exporting.
